'''Ord Fanthal'''<ref name="EGTW" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term "[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]" and the abbreviation "Ord" applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> located in the [[Ord Fanthal system/Legends|Ord Fanthal system]], a part of the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TransHydian" /> Ord Fanthal served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], despite it being located outside the borders of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During that time, Ord Fanthal was situated in what was considered to be [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. When the Republic launched the [[Crusade of the Wilds]] against the various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] inhabiting space north of its borders in [[11,791 BBY]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] advanced from Ord Fanthal in the [[trailing]] direction.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
A world named "Ord Fenthal" was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Later, however, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and Fry, only listed an "Ord Fanthal" [[Star system/Legends|star system]], which it placed in grid square O-7. This article therefore assumes that the name of the world from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' was changed to the latter variant.<ref name="EAOC" />
